name: VW blower fan
description: Original Volkswagen centrifugal blower assembly, made in Germany. 12V. Tested and working. Exact VW application/part number not confirmed.

name: GT brakes - front and rear
description: Porsche 356 Carrera/GT-type front and rear drum brake set. Front setup includes 60mm drums with Fuchs fox-head markings, 60mm brake shoes marked "SG", aluminum CNC wheel-cylinder lifts/spacers, wheel cylinders, springs, and all 8 pistons. Some small parts/bushings may still be required. Rear setup uses 40mm drums with rebuilt complete backing-plate assemblies. Includes additional springs and miscellaneous brake hardware. Please review photos carefully for exactly what is included and condition.

name: Solex 40 PII-4 carburetors with intake manifolds - unrestored
description: Pair of unrestored Solex 40 PII-4 split-shaft carburetors with intake manifolds. Surprisingly good condition, no corrosion, just dirty. Parts move freely. I think these look nice but will need restoration.

name: Solex 40 PII-4 carburetors - restored
description: Pair of Solex 40 PII-4 carburetors professionally restored/remanufactured by Bieker Engineering. Restoration documents included. Unused since restoration. Intake manifolds not included.

name: 1600 Super engine case
description: Not yet for sale. Since there are two cases and at least one set of restoration documents I want to more thoroughly understand what it is I'm listing here. I have a lot of heads and some are restored but they've been in storage too long without dessicant. There appears to be parts for a whole engine scattered around here. 1962 Porsche 356B 1600 Super engine case, type 616/12 - P702319. All three pieces matched (99). More parts to be added.

name: Shroud with fan wheel and linkage assembly
description: You will need ball joints. Fan shroud, fan cover, linkages, shroud body. As pictured. There is a small patch of dings in the mouth of the shroud. Looks workable.
